_: batman (Stern Batman 66) on Daphishbowl and Mr H.'s 'Batman 66' 1.1.0 (cGameName
b66_orig), a scripted tribute with PinUP Player: vpxshadow.py keeps its script as a
shadow game and hands the ball to the real game. The rig has ONE batman card (no
LE/Premium split in rigtables), so there is no `preferred`. Every switch is placed
by the table's object coordinates against the rig's switch_xy.txt (table x,y ~=
drawing x*3.34-75, y*3.34-142) and the hit sub's own comments; lights the same
way against led_io.txt (every insert named below sits within a few drawing pixels
of its LED). The turntable (switches 76-79), the crane (82-87) and the bat spinner
optos (105/106) are node-board motors / a disc with no coil in device_xy.txt: the
PadMechTimer in extra_vbs makes the tribute's own turntable and crane FOLLOW the
machine's position switches (Controller.Switch get = the rig's switch plane) and
turns the tribute's spinning bat disc's half turns into the two optos.
quiet_subs: the tribute's light shows, plus the hit subs of objects the machine
has no switch for (they run the shadow game's rules: back gate, ball lock, combos),
and its crane-mode sweep tmrCrane_Timer: the crane is the machine's (PAD-971).
helper_balls: the tribute's three unseen balls, the bat disc's two posts and the
crane's spring. At the phone the disc rides over trgBallLock3, which the table
then reported as TURNTABLE LOCK 3, and the machine turned the turntable home from
the phone and out again, for good (PAD-974).
PAD-1120: CONTROL GATE (6) and DIVERTER POWER (7) are two parts (the game's own
adjustments: DISABLE LEFT CONTROL GATE, DISABLE TURNTABLE DIVERTER). Both used to open
the turntable lock door, so every combo or skill shot that opened the left control
gate sent the orbit ball behind the turntable, stuck behind the Bat Phone. 6 now
swings Gate002, 7 alone opens the lock door.
PAD-1251: PadMechTimer runs under On Error Resume Next, so a failing call of the
tribute's (TurnTable_Goto, CraneGoto) left its mechs still without a word: PadNote
puts each distinct error into the controller log (Controller.PadNote).
title: batman

7.name: DIVERTER POWER (the game's TURNTABLE DIVERTER: the tribute's back door WallDoor1 to the turntable lock)

extra_vbs:
'---- PAD: Batman 66's mechs follow the machine
Dim PadNoteLast, PadGateA, PadGateB, PadTTWant, PadCraneWant, PadDiscLast
PadGateA = False : PadGateB = False : PadTTWant = 0 : PadCraneWant = -1 : PadDiscLast = 0
Sub PadAutoPlunge(e)
	If CBool(e) Then
		plungerIM.AutoFire
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadMagnet(e)
	mMagnaSave.MagnetOn = CBool(e)
End Sub
Sub PadControlGate(e)
	PadGateB = CBool(e)
	PadApplyGate
End Sub
Sub PadDiverterPower(e)
	PadGateA = CBool(e)
	PadApplyGate
End Sub
Sub PadApplyGate   ' held where the machine has them
	' PAD-1120: DIVERTER POWER is the turntable diverter, the tribute's OpenPFAGate (WallDoor1 open sends the orbit ball to the lock behind the turntable)
	' the lane behind the turntable leads somewhere at two faces only: the lock at the TV, and on through the Batcave (the tribute drops its lane wall there;
	' the game holds 7 with the lock release there for many seconds). At the Phone, or turning, an open door drops the ball behind the turntable for good
	Dim o
	o = PadGateA
	If o Then o = (CurMechPos = kTT_TV Or CurMechPos = kTT_Batcave) And Not tmrTurntable.Enabled
	If WallDoor1.Collidable <> o Then
		WallDoor1.Collidable = o
		WallDoor1.Visible = o
		WallDoor2.Collidable = Not o
		WallDoor2.Visible = Not o
	End If
	' CONTROL GATE is the LEFT control gate at the top of the orbit, the tribute's Gate002 (open lets a right loop ball on round to the left loop)
	If Gate002.Open <> PadGateB Then Gate002.Open = PadGateB
End Sub
Sub PadLockRelease(e)
	If CBool(e) Then
		RPFA_BallLockPos1.Collidable = False
		RPFA_BallLockPost.Visible = False
		vpmTimer.AddTimer 2000, "PadLockPostUp '"
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadLockPostUp
	If CurMechPos = kTT_TV Then
		RPFA_BallLockPos1.Collidable = True
		RPFA_BallLockPost.Visible = True
	End If
End Sub
Function PadSw(n)   ' the machine's switch plane; False when the controller cannot say
	PadSw = False
	On Error Resume Next
	PadSw = CBool(Controller.Switch(n + 0))
End Function
Sub PadNote(what)   ' PAD-1251: a call of the tribute's that failed under On Error Resume Next, into the controller log once per error
	If Err.Number = 0 Then Exit Sub
	Dim d : d = what & ": VBScript error " & Err.Number & " (" & Err.Description & ")"
	Err.Clear
	If d = PadNoteLast Then Exit Sub
	PadNoteLast = d
	Controller.PadNote = d
	Err.Clear
End Sub
Sub PadMechTimer_Timer
	On Error Resume Next
	Dim want, i
	' the lock lane's triggers stay armed (the shadow game only arms them in its own lock mode)
	trgBallLock1.Enabled = True
	trgBallLock2.Enabled = True
	trgBallLock3.Enabled = True
	PadNote "lock lane triggers"
	PadApplyGate
	PadNote "PadApplyGate"
	' the turntable: position #1 home, #2, #3 away -> the tribute's TV, Phone, Batcave faces
	want = 0
	If PadSw(1077) Then want = kTT_TV
	If PadSw(1078) Then want = kTT_Phone
	If PadSw(1079) Then want = kTT_Batcave
	If want <> 0 And want <> PadTTWant Then
		PadTTWant = want
		TurnTable_Goto want
		PadNote "TurnTable_Goto " & want
	End If
	' PAD-971: the tribute's own rules turn it too (ball search, its lock modes); the machine's place wins
	If PadTTWant <> 0 Then
		If tmrTurntable.Enabled Then
			If tmrTurntable.UserValue <> PadTTWant Then tmrTurntable.UserValue = PadTTWant   ' its turn steps to UserValue
		ElseIf CurMechPos <> PadTTWant Then
			TurnTable_Goto PadTTWant
		End If
		PadNote "turntable to " & PadTTWant
	End If
	' the crane: position #1 home (switch 87) .. #6 away (82) -> CraneGoto 0..5
	For i = 0 To 5
		If PadSw(1087 - i) Then
			If i <> PadCraneWant Then
				PadCraneWant = i
				CraneGoto i
				PadNote "CraneGoto " & i
			End If
		End If
	Next
	' PAD-971: the tribute's own rules swing it too (a player's saved state, its ball search); the machine's place wins
	If PadCraneWant >= 0 Then
		If CranePosIdx <> PadCraneWant Then CraneGoto PadCraneWant
		PadNote "crane to " & PadCraneWant
	End If
	' the bat spinner disc: each half turn passes the machine's two optos, in its direction
	If discLastPos <> PadDiscLast Then
		If PadDiscLast <> 0 Then
			If discSpinSpeed > 0 Then
				vpmTimer.PulseSw 1105
				vpmTimer.AddTimer 30, "vpmTimer.PulseSw 1106 '"
			Else
				vpmTimer.PulseSw 1106
				vpmTimer.AddTimer 30, "vpmTimer.PulseSw 1105 '"
			End If
		End If
		PadDiscLast = discLastPos
	End If
	PadNote "bat disc optos"
End Sub
'---- PAD-859: the inserts the tribute shows without a Light
Sub PadBulb(i, v)   ' one of the tribute's fader bulbs (Lampz 1-12), shown: its own modes hide l7-l12
	Dim nm : nm = Array("", "80", "81", "82", "83", "84", "85", "7", "8", "9", "10", "11", "12")(i)
	Execute "pFiliment" & nm & ".Visible = True : l" & nm & ".Visible = True : pFBase" & nm & ".Visible = True"
	Lampz.state(i) = Abs(v <> 0)
End Sub
Sub PadCatBulbs(first, v)   ' a Catwoman billboard: its three C-A-T bulbs together
	Dim i
	For i = first To first + 2 : PadBulb i, v : Next
End Sub
Sub PadPop(n, v)   ' a pop bumper's insert: the tribute lights its plastic
	Dim img : img = "B66_Popbumpers_GIOFFB"
	If v <> 0 Then img = "B66_Popbumpers_GION"
	Select Case n
		Case 1 : B66_PlasticPop1.Image = img
		Case 2 : B66_PlasticPop2.Image = img
		Case 3 : B66_PlasticPop3.Image = img
	End Select
End Sub
Sub PadBatSignal(a, v)
	SetLightFlasher flshBatSignal, Abs(v <> 0)
End Sub

lamps._: table light -> Spike 2 LEDs [node, index] (several = an RGB insert: lit when any is); every one placed against led_io.txt's position and matching the script's use; GUESS = the names differ

lTV.name: SEASONS (GUESS: the tribute's TV-ready light sits on it)

lamp_calls._: inserts the tribute shows with something other than a Light: `call` is a sub of extra_vbs, called (arg, value) when the machine's LED changes; `show` names the objects that show it (PAD-859)

PadCatLeftBillboard.name: CATWOMAN LEFT BILLBOARD (the tribute's left C-A-T bulbs, Lampz 1-3)

PadCatRightBillboard.name: CATWOMAN RIGHT BILLBOARD (the right C-A-T bulbs, Lampz 4-6)

retrofit_lights._: LE inserts with no table object: a new Light cloned from `clone`, at [x, y] (the led_io position through the fit of the mapped lights, PAD-859)
